Transcription with verbose JSON response format including timestamp segments

```swift title="Swift"
import Foundation
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.createTranscriptionRequestFromJson("{\"file\":\"audio.mp3\",\"model\":\"whisper-1\",\"response_format\":\"verbose_json\"}")
guard let _apiKey = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["API_KEY"] else { fatalError("API_KEY must be set") }
let _client = try createClient(apiKey: _apiKey, baseUrl: nil)
let result = try await _client.transcribe(_req)
debugPrint(result.text)
debugPrint(result.segments as Any)
debugPrint(result.segments?[0].id as Any)
```
